title: Security Deposit Account Repair Labor Rate for Long Tenancies
content:
The labor rate for a damage repair charge on a Security Deposit Account follows the tenancy and its payment record on the Apartment Home Lease:

| Tenancy, full months from move-in to move-out | Returned payments on the lease in the twelve full months before the handling date | Labor rate per hour |
|---|---|---|
| 48 or more | none | 52.00 USD |
| 48 or more | exactly one | 58.50 USD |
| 48 or more | two or more | the program's maintenance labor rate |
| fewer than 48 | any | the program's maintenance labor rate |

**Stated as a rule.** The labor rate is:

- 52.00 USD for a tenancy of at least 48 full months from the lease's move-in date to its move-out date, with no returned payment dated on the lease fewer than twelve full months before the handling date;
- 58.50 USD for a tenancy of at least 48 full months with exactly one returned payment dated in those twelve months;
- the program's maintenance labor rate for any other tenancy.

**Records read.** From the Apartment Home Lease: the move-in date, and the returned payments on the lease ledger with their dates. From the deposit account: the move-out date.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- 60 full months of tenancy, no returned payments in the last twelve months: 52.00 USD per hour. Three hours of labor come to 156.00 USD.
- 60 full months, one returned payment eight months before the handling date: 58.50 USD per hour.
- 40 full months: the program's rate.
